scene_description: A multi-wing temple complex centered around an activated beacon with a visible beam. The player spawns at origin facing north. A jungle sign is placed ~8.6 blocks south-southwest requiring navigation to find. The sign directs them north to the central beacon plaza (proper 3x3 iron pyramid with open sky guaranteed by tall air column). From the beacon, two paths branch: (1) East - stone stairs (facing=west, ascending eastward) leading up to an upper level with stone brick walls, polished granite floor, white terracotta embedded in walls, and a crafting table with materials; (2) West - a gravel path with raised eye-level pillars leading to smooth sandstone stairs (facing=west, ascending westward) and a desert wing workshop with oak logs and crafting table.
task_text: Explore the ancient temple complex. Find the jungle sign south of spawn, then follow its directions north to the beacon in the central plaza. From the beacon, climb the stone stairs to the east to discover the upper level with stone bricks, polished granite, and white terracotta to mine. Craft an orange carpet at the upper level workstation. Also follow the gravel path west from the beacon to the desert wing, climb the smooth sandstone stairs, and craft oak slabs in the workshop.
